toolchain: nightly-2026-07-10
          components: rustfmt, clippy

      - name: Setup sccache
        uses: mozilla-actions/sccache-action@v0.0.10
        with:
          version: "v0.16.0"

      - name: Install protobuf compiler
        id: deps
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y protobuf-compiler

      - name: Run pegainfer-build unit tests
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.deps.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: cargo test --release --locked -p pegainfer-build --lib

      - name: Run pegainfer-frontend unit tests
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.deps.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: cargo test --release --locked -p pegainfer-frontend --lib

      - name: Run pegainfer-sim unit tests
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.deps.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: cargo test --release --locked -p pegainfer-sim --lib

      - name: Run kvbm-logical unit tests
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.deps.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: cargo test --release --locked -p kvbm-logical --lib

  cpu-clippy:
    if: github.event_name == 'push' || github.event.pull_request.draft == false
    name: CPU Clippy
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      RUSTC_WRAPPER: sccache
      SCCACHE_GHA_ENABLED: "true"

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: nightly-2026-07-10
          components: rustfmt, clippy

      - name: Setup sccache
        uses: mozilla-actions/sccache-action@v0.0.10
        with:
          version: "v0.16.0"

      - name: Install protobuf compiler
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y protobuf-compiler

      - name: Run CPU Clippy
        run: >-
          cargo clippy --release --locked
          -p pegainfer-build
          -p pegainfer-frontend
          -p pegainfer-sim
          -p kvbm-logical
          --all-targets -- -D warnings

  simulated-frontend-e2e:
    if: github.event_name == 'push' || github.event.pull_request.draft == false
    name: Simulated frontend E2E
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:

I now have a complete picture:

**Project scope**: `pegainfer-build` — a tiny build-time helper library crate in the PegaInfer workspace (Rust LLM inference engine). Single source file `src/lib.rs` (299 lines). It resolves the CUDA toolkit installation at build time across three layouts (classic `/usr/local/cuda`, conda `targets/<arch>/`, NVIDIA HPC SDK with math_libs sibling), exposes `CudaToolkit` (root, nvcc, include_dirs, lib_dirs) with `discover()`, `header_dir()`, `link_search()`. Consumed as a `[build-dependencies]` by `pegainfer-kernels/build.rs` (nvcc compilation of CUDA kernels) and `pegainfer-cupti/build.rs` (CUPTI profiler). Tested via tempfile-built fake toolkit trees (TempTree fixture); CI runs `cargo test --release --locked -p pegainfer-build --lib` on CPU (no GPU needed). Edition 2024, uses let-chains (`if let ... && ...`).

Key learning themes for a tutorial:
1. Position in workspace: pure Rust + CUDA inference engine, build system, why build-time discovery matters (no cmake-sys etc., no Python).
2. Cargo build script protocol: `cargo:` directives (`rustc-link-search`, `warning`, `rerun-if-env-changed`), `[build-dependencies]`, host vs target distinction.
3. CUDA toolkit layouts: classic, conda, HPC SDK, aarch64 `targets` variants.
4. The Rust API: `CudaToolkit::discover/from_root/header_dir/link_search`, `target_dirs`, `existing_deduped`, `find_package`.
5. Diagnostics design: warnings vs panics with actionable hints.
6. Cargo caching semantics: `rerun-if-env-changed` — subtle and important.
7. Testing: fake filesystem trees with tempfile, deterministic tests without a GPU or CUDA install; should_panic tests; unix-only symlink tests.
8. Consumers: kernels build.rs (nvcc, header_dir for host compiler includes, link_search at end), cupti build.rs (extras/CUPTI).
9. History/evolution: extracted from openinfer-comm-build-utils in #343; find_package demoted to cfg(test); visibility lints (hawk); edition 2024 let-chains.
10. Extension practice: add support for a new layout (e.g., conda `cuda-toolkit` prefix or apt-installed `/usr/lib/cuda`), generalize probing into find_package revival, add a `link_libs` helper, test with TempTree.

Now, how many lectures? The crate is tiny — a single 299-line file. Per rules: 小型项目 8 到 15 篇; "不要为了数量硬拆，逻辑优先". I think ~10 lectures is right, organized in 3 units:

**Unit 1 (beginner): 从零认识 pegainfer-build**
- u1-l1: Project overview — what is pegainfer-build, its position in the PegaInfer workspace, why a pure-Rust engine needs build-time CUDA discovery; the architecture map. call_95a44c9e4497419e9b7f79a9.head: 223206b7ddbc7441063741484d9aa610d5ed9bb0
call_95a44c9e4497419e9b7f79a9.rationale: pegainfer-build 是 PegaInfer 工作区中一个单文件、约 300 行的构建辅助库（源头是 e2073505 从各 build.rs 中抽出的共享 CUDA 探测逻辑），初学者真正的门槛不是这份代码本身，而是它运行的特殊环境——Cargo build script 协议与 CUDA 工具包的多种安装布局。因此学习路线分三层递进：入门层先建立工作区定位与 build script 协议的心智模型，学会跑通它的纯 CPU 测试；进阶层按调用链逐函数精读 discover→target_dirs→from_root 的三种布局探测，以及结果收敛与 link_search 输出；专家层覆盖无 GPU 的 TempTree 测试设计、pegainfer-kernels 与 pegainfer-cupti 两个真实消费方的集成、rerun-if 缓存语义的正确性分析，最后以「扩展一种新工具包布局」作为贯穿全部知识的实战。所有实践任务都可以在没有 GPU、甚至没有 CUDA 安装的机器上完成，与 CI 中 cpu-tests 跑 `cargo test -p pegainfer-build --lib` 的设计保持一致。

data.head: 223206b7ddbc7441063741484d9aa610d5ed9bb0
data.rationale: pegainfer-build 是 PegaInfer 工作区中一个单文件、约 300 行的构建辅助库（源头是 e2073505 从各 build.rs 中抽出的共享 CUDA 探测逻辑），初学者真正的门槛不是这份代码本身，而是它运行的特殊环境——Cargo build script 协议与 CUDA 工具包的多种安装布局。因此学习路线分三层递进：入门层先建立工作区定位与 build script 协议的心智模型，学会跑通它的纯 CPU 测试；进阶层按调用链逐函数精读 discover→target_dirs→from_root 的三种布局探测，以及结果收敛与 link_search 输出；专家层覆盖无 GPU 的 TempTree 测试设计、pegainfer-kernels 与 pegainfer-cupti 两个真实消费方的集成、rerun-if 缓存语义的正确性分析，最后以「扩展一种新工具包布局」作为贯穿全部知识的实战。所有实践任务都可以在没有 GPU、甚至没有 CUDA 安装的机器上完成，与 CI 中 cpu-tests 跑 `cargo test -p pegainfer-build --lib` 的设计保持一致。

lectures.topic: 精读探测结果的收敛与输出环节：existing_deduped 过滤不存在目录并用 canonicalize 去重（conda 安装常用符号链接指向 targets 目录）、header_dir 帮宿主编译器定位真正包含指定头文件的目录、link_search 发射 cargo:rustc-link-search 指令并在无库目录时告警。
